title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Yet interfaces centered on screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions can impose a human-interaction prior, requiring repeated screen interpretation while leaving the computer's semantic and programmatic capabilities underexposed. We argue for exposing these capabilities and letting models choose and combine them. We introduce Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a unified interface for general agents that combines three complementary channels: programmatic interaction through code and command-line tools, semantic interaction through accessibility (AX), and visual interaction through graphical user interfaces (GUI). Our HCU supports efficient AX interaction and guards against stale-state actions during channel switching. A supplementary HCU skill guides agents in selecting and coordinating channels to use the unified int

translated_title: 混合计算机使用：面向通用智能体的统一编程、语义与视觉接口
translated_abstract: 使用计算机的智能体日益承担从日常桌面活动到长程专业工作流的各类任务。然而，以截图和鼠标键盘操作为中心的接口会强加一种“人类交互先验”，需要反复解读屏幕内容，同时使计算机的语义与编程能力得不到充分展现。我们主张暴露这些能力，并让模型自主选择和组合它们。我们提出了混合计算机使用，这是一个面向通用智能体的统一接口，结合了三个互补的交互通道：通过代码和命令行工具进行的编程式交互、通过无障碍功能进行的语义交互，以及通过图形用户界面进行的视觉交互。我们的 HCU 支持高效的 AX 交互，并在通道切换时防范基于过时状态的操作。补充的 HCU 技能可指导智能体选择和协调各通道，以有效使用统一接口。
tldr: 该论文提出混合计算机使用（HCU），一个统一融合编程式、语义与视觉三种交互通道的通用智能体接口，使智能体能够自主选择和组合各通道，从而突破传统“截图+鼠标键盘”人类交互先验的局限。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a unified interface that combines programmatic, semantic, and visual interaction channels, enabling general agents to choose and coordinate among them to overcome the limitations of the screenshot-based human-interaction prior.
